caption: The drawing depicts a single brown ceramic pitcher positioned centrally within a rectangular frame sketched lightly in black lines. The pitcher has a rounded body, a narrow neck that widens at the top, and a slightly flared spout. The handle on the left side is indicated with dashed lines, as are the extremities of the spout and rim, suggesting a transparent or incomplete rendering of these parts. The body of the pitcher features irregular dark brown streaks and spots that run vertically, as well as a small circular mark on the right side. The shading throughout the pitcher creates a three-dimensional effect, highlighting its curves and cylindrical form. The drawing is done in brown tones, and the background is plain and off-white. The name "Annie B. Johnston." is written in the bottom right corner within the frame.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
